checks.note: On refund success the catch block in purchasePack writes no marker (recordReconciliation runs only when the lookup or refund fails), and both replay guards — the alreadyRecorded pre-check and the winner lookup — consult only sessionPackPurchaseRepository.findByStripePaymentIntentId, never the refund status or reconciliation records; a same-key retry therefore passes both checks and createPurchase commits a pack funded by the refunded intent.

The catch around createPurchase in purchasePack is a blanket catch(Exception) and the winner lookup (findByStripePaymentIntentId) sees only committed rows before refunding, so the mechanism holds if the insert can fail with a lock timeout — but whether lock_timeout/statement_timeout is set on that path (the finding's own verification condition) and createPurchase's transaction boundaries are not in the shown diff.

onBookingCancelledByParent does gate only on sessionPackPurchaseId != null && isRefundEligible() while all sibling paths use isPackRestore(), but whether this over-restores depends on BookingCancelledByParentEvent's publisher and contract (is it published for uncaptured REQUESTED/ACCEPTED pack bookings, and does it expose a captured/isPackRestore flag) — neither is in the provided hunks.
